proposal.thesis: NetApp is the top scan setup (7.74) and the only open path to a new seat, since the book sits just over 40% deployed and every held driver is capped at one seat; hyperscaler_server_capex has none and NTAP correlates -0.03 with the book. The fundamentals are accelerating: quarter ended 2026-07-31 revenue $1.819B (+25.9% y/y), TTM FCF $1.65B, net debt/EBITDA 0.51, and four straight EPS beats with the last at $2.58 vs $2.12 (+21.5%). Evercore upgraded it to Outperform on 2026-10-07 arguing the FY27 guide (about 17% growth, implying a second-half slowdown to about 9%) is too conservative, while the bundle's consensus target ($211.69) still sits 9% below price. It is extended (RSI 71.8 after +19% in ten sessions), so this is an honest 0.56 calibration probe with a stop under the early-October shelf (KB-7057672046), not a full-size chase.
catalysts: Estimate revisions following the 2026-10-07 Evercore upgrade and the post-INSIGHT target raises, through October-November 2026
Hyperscaler Q3 capex commentary in late October 2026 (data-center storage demand read-through)
Q2 FY27 earnings on 2026-12-01 (outside the horizon; exit or re-underwrite before it)
proposal.macro_context: SPY is above its 50- and 200-DMA with a supportive read and a healthy momentum factor, so normal aggression applies. Rising 10-year yields (5.28%) and widening HY spreads argue against long-duration software adds; NTAP trades on near-term revenue and FCF rather than distant cash flows, and it diversifies a book whose current beta is 0.52.
proposal.risk_map: Kills: a daily close below $217 (the early-October shelf fails and the breakout is undone), estimate cuts or a sell-side reversal of the October upgrades, or a hyperscaler capex pause that hits storage orders. Early warning: a close back below the $229 flag low within the first week, which would say the leg is distributing rather than flagging.
proposal.variant_perception: CONSENSUS: the bundle shows 16 analysts at a 2.2 mean rating with a $211.69 mean target, 9.2% below the price, so the street treats NTAP as a fully priced legacy storage vendor after a big 2026. MY VIEW: the business has re-rated into an AI data-infrastructure supplier whose growth is not decelerating as fast as the guide says. MECHANISM: street models extrapolate management's FY27 guide, which implies second-half growth near 9%, yet NTAP has beaten four straight quarters with the last EPS beat at +21.5%, so models anchored to the guide keep getting revised up and the stale mean target is the evidence they are behind. RESOLUTION: target and estimate revisions through November and price holding the $229 flag low; the 2026-12-01 Q2 FY27 print is the final test, which this trade plans to exit or re-underwrite before.

thesis_invalidators.invalidating_print: Any company update or sell-side estimate cut showing FY27 revenue tracking at or below the 17% guide, or a hyperscaler capex cut that names storage, kills the revision thesis.
thesis_invalidators.invalidating_structure: A daily close below $217, under the 10/1-10/2 shelf lows, means the breakout leg has failed; exit on that close.
thesis_invalidators.time_box: If NTAP has not made a daily close above $250 by 2026-11-06, cut or exit; hard exit by the 2026-11-28 close, before the 2026-12-01 print.
